newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Congo's Kabila tours military camps in Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: Congo's Kabila tours military camps in Eritrea.

text.p: President Laurent Kabila of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on Thursday toured Eritrean military training facilities in the western region of the Red Sea state, the state-run news agency reported.
Kabila arrived in Eritrea on Wednesday on a three-day state visit at the invitation of President Isaias Afewerki, himself a former guerrilla leader.
Officials said Kabila, who seized power in the former Zaire in May after ousting longtime leader Mobutu Sese Seko, would return to Asmara later on Thursday and hold more talks with Afewerki.
The officials said Kabila would also hold talks with business leaders and executives before returning home on Friday. Kabila has pledged reform after decades of economic mismanagement under Mobutu.
